Sell-to-buy in the launch window was 0.89, meaning sellers were nearly matching buyers from the start. Sell count (862) is high relative to buyers, and the launch bot was present. Sellers outnumbering buyers in the recent window suggests demand is fading rather than holding. Round-trip costs of 1.4-5.1% also come out of any gain, and the 30-second execution lag means we'd enter at a price that may have moved.

The honest answer: there's no strong case that demand will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. The bull points are real but backward-looking. I'd skip.
